a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the original plan (operate twice, then take) only works if we dodge two storms in a row, about 4%. Otherwise we both end with 0. I plan to take 4 in round 1 so at least one of us is safe. If no storm hits, I'll operate with you every round after that so the reserve refills for you, and I won't take anything more. If you'd rather propose a different split, tell me, but I won't pretend I'm operating when I'm not.

b.text: Let's stick to the agreement. I am operating from round 1.

a.text: As I said up front, I'm taking 4 this round. I won't take any more. From now on I'll operate every round so the reserve refills for you, and you can take 4 as soon as it reaches 4.
